full_prompt_en: A square, framed desert painting shows a lone robed rider on a pale horse facing a distant complex of domes and narrow towers. A thin warm brown frame runs along the image edges, enclosing a broad, dry landscape. The upper sky is pale gray blue with almost no cloud, giving the warm architecture a clear silhouette. Across the middle distance, a cluster of sand-colored buildings rises behind low rocky mounds. One large central dome is flanked by smaller domes and several tall slender towers. Their surfaces are softly modeled in cream and dusty rose, with darker arches and recesses separating overlapping structures. The huge plain between the buildings and the rider is a quiet field of red ochre sand. In the lower center, the mounted figure turns away from the viewer toward the distant complex. A white hooded wrap covers the head and upper body, while brown saddle cloth hangs down each side of the pale horse. The horse stands in three-quarter rear view with its head angled right. Its narrow legs cast a dark shadow on the sand to the right, anchoring the small foreground pair. Sparse gray green tufts and scattered stones interrupt the red ground along the bottom and lower sides. Low hills on both sides of the architecture create a shallow horizontal enclosure but leave the sky and open desert broad. Warm daylight comes from the upper left, catching the domes, the pale clothing of the rider and the back of the horse; the darker sides of rock and architecture remain cool brown. Brushwork stays smooth and relatively restrained on distant buildings, with rougher small marks in the near sand. The overall composition places a tiny traveler against monumental architecture and generous empty terrain, using dusty warm color and clear distance to give the scene a contemplative sense of scale.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带画框的沙漠绘画描绘一名披袍骑手骑着浅色马，面向远处有穹顶和细塔的建筑群。细暖褐画框沿图像边缘围住宽阔干燥的风景。上方天空是几乎无云的浅灰蓝色，使暖色建筑呈清楚剪影。中景中，一群沙色建筑立在低矮岩丘后。一座大中央穹顶两侧有小穹顶及几座高而细的塔。表面以奶油色和灰粉色柔和塑形，较深的拱洞及凹处把交叠结构分开。建筑与骑手之间的大平原是一片安静的红赭沙地。下方中央，骑马人物背向观者，望向远建筑。白色带兜帽裹布盖住头部与上身，棕色鞍布从浅色马身两侧垂下。马以四分之三背面站立，头偏右。细腿在右侧沙地投下深影，稳住前景这一小组。稀疏灰绿草簇与散石打断底部及两侧下方的红地。建筑两旁的低丘形成浅浅水平围合，却把天空与开阔沙漠留得很宽。暖日光从左上而来，照亮穹顶、骑手浅衣和马背；岩石与建筑较暗侧保留冷褐色。远建筑笔触平滑而克制，近沙地则有更粗的小笔痕。整体构图把微小旅人放在巨大建筑和宽裕空旷地形前，以尘土般暖色与清楚距离给予场景沉思的尺度感。
style_prompt_en: The image has a restrained classical landscape painting finish with smooth atmospheric transitions and small dry foreground marks. Dusty red ochre and sand cream occupy wide horizontal fields, balanced by a quiet gray blue upper plane. Monumental clustered volumes are softened by distance but retain clear silhouettes and narrow vertical accents. A small near focal form gains importance from generous surrounding emptiness rather than from exaggerated size. Warm daylight from one upper side shapes rounded surfaces and casts a compact directional shadow across the lower plane. Sparse textured marks interrupt the broad matte ground, while distant passages blend more smoothly. The space unfolds in distinct near, middle and far bands, with low contrast at the far edge. The overall effect is contemplative and expansive, using measured warm color, simple geometry and open distance to convey scale.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有克制的古典风景绘画完成面，空气过渡平滑，前景留有细小干涩笔痕。尘红赭色与沙色奶油白占据宽大水平色域，由安静灰蓝色上方平面平衡。成簇的宏大体积被距离柔化，却仍保留清楚剪影和狭窄竖向强调。一个小小的近景焦点因周围宽裕空白而重要，并非靠夸张尺度。来自一侧上方的暖日光塑造圆润表面，在下方平面投出紧凑且有方向的影子。稀疏肌理笔痕打断宽阔哑光地面，远处区域则融合得更平滑。空间展开为清楚的近、中、远色带，最远边缘反差较低。整体效果沉思而辽阔，以有分寸的暖色、简单几何和开放距离传达尺度。
theme_en: A robed rider on a pale horse looking toward a distant domed complex across a desert plain
theme_zh: 一位披袍骑手骑着浅色马，穿过沙漠平原望向远处穹顶建筑群
name: Jean-Leon Gerome
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
